chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Qutaybah al-A'sha, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:
Indeed, among the people with the most intense punishment on the Day of Judgment is the one who portrayed justice and acted without it.

key_terms.أَشَدِّ النَّاسِ عَذَاباً: The most intense punishment of the people

ai.seo_question: Who faces the most severe punishment on the Day of Judgment according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this hadith from *Al-Kafi* specifically targets the elite and leaders who project an image of equity (*adl*) while practicing injustice, a condition often linked to *Nifaq* (hypocrisy). It serves as a stern warning against the dissonance between public persona and private conduct, emphasizing that the severity of punishment is proportional to the expectation of justice placed upon them by the community.
